scope: Diagnosis of the original three candidates before looking at iteration model outputs
factual_correction: The original audit did not establish all three exact methods were previously published. O1/O2 were awaiting evidence, O3 deferred with rejection of its broad claim. Failing the combined GO gate was not the same as proving non-novelty.

cases.genuine_overlap: Consensus, dispersion/covariance rejection, all-query accounting and common-mode inflation already appear in RIC-Loc; generic confidence fusion is anticipated in RIM.
cases.surviving_distinction: The exact additional predictive value of a specified footprint-dependence statistic is not settled by those sources.
cases.evidence_gap: No measured incremental value beyond footprint count, complete confidence fusion and common-mode baselines; original leave-cluster-out score can remain stable for a consistently wrong alias.
cases.feasibility_gap: No frozen posed-reference outputs, independent geographic split or matched RIC-Loc baseline demonstrated.
cases.overconservatism: No evidence that the actual auditor incorrectly declared the exact diagnostic established; it explicitly retained a narrow unresolved question.
cases.correct_disposition: Revise/test diagnostic subject to prerequisites; do not promote as novel and do not reject only because results are absent.

cases.genuine_overlap: Per-pixel confidence exists in SkyReg and generic propagated camera/height uncertainty is established. Constant-height finite differences can reduce to tan(off-nadir angle).
cases.surviving_distinction: Reliability under an independently erroneous external DSM could differ from confidence in reconstruction-derived geometry, but a precise non-equivalent diagnostic was not specified.
cases.evidence_gap: No superiority beyond analytic propagation, viewing-angle/slope or existing point confidence; same-reconstruction truth risks circular validation.
cases.feasibility_gap: Independent map-error truth, coordinate transforms and actual public modalities had not been downloaded and checked.
cases.overconservatism: The existing audit labels a strong threat and insufficient specification, not proof the exact score exists. Lack of data blocks testing, not novelty.
cases.correct_disposition: Separate method novelty from map/truth validity; retain as a scientific question only until a distinct operational quantity is specified.

cases.genuine_overlap: HF-Net covisibility grouping, RIC-Loc proposed geometry-aware reference selection, and OASIS information-based subset selection defeat broad novelty claims for diversity/support under a budget.
cases.surviving_distinction: A specific pre-match utility estimator with uncertain associations might differ; none was supplied.
cases.evidence_gap: No comparison against geographic NMS/covisibility; uncharged support probes and oracle reference crops would invalidate the claimed advantage.
cases.feasibility_gap: Requires a non-oracle gallery and full online cost ledger, not only paired OrthoLoC crops.
cases.overconservatism: Future-work anticipation is not an implemented equivalent. Broad-claim rejection is justified, but it does not prove every narrower rule unoriginal.
cases.correct_disposition: Keep broad claim rejected; reopen only with an explicit marginal-utility mechanism and matched-budget control.

hypotheses_about_failure.unoriginality: Strong broad-principle overlap in all three; exact-method identity not established in O1/O2.
hypotheses_about_failure.narrow_space: All three operate on existing retrieval/matching outputs through confidence, gating or selection. Descriptive concentration in post-hoc scoring/selection is visible; no causal ablation established it caused failure.
hypotheses_about_failure.overaggressive_investigator: Unmeasured by the original five positive controls; original candidate prose was more nuanced than a blanket rejection.
hypotheses_about_failure.novelty_evidence_conflation: The aggregate GO gate correctly required both. The runtime previously accepted fatal_overlap=true without a source quotation or rejection basis; corrected to disallow unsupported novelty rejection. This is a demonstrated software risk, not proof it caused the original candidate outcomes.

corrections: Keep novelty, empirical evidence, significance and feasibility as separate axes.
Require a known-source quotation for fatal overlap and fail contradictory classification/flag combinations.
Measure balanced false novelty and false rejection under explicit evidence scope.
Compare old and revised generators on the same corpus; blind reviewer to generator condition.
No threshold relaxation and no requirement to produce a survivor.
